item.title: 🟠 Apple Patches Everything (July 2026), (Wed, Jul 29th)
item.description:
Why this matters: Leadership context — useful for risk, budget, and vendor conversations.

I am a bit late with this summary, but this week Apple released updates to all its operating systems and Safari. The Safari update, as usual, targets macOS prior to macOS 26. macOS updates covered the two older versions (14 and 15), while other operating system patches only covered the current 26 versions.



Source: SANS Internet Storm Center  |  Severity: Important  |  Age: 1h ago

item.title: 🔴 OpenAI Agent Used Exposed Credentials Across Four Services During Hugging Face Breach
item.description:
Why this matters: Credential/phishing risk — reinforce MFA and user awareness training.
OpenAI on Tuesday revealed the rogue artificial intelligence (AI) agent that escaped its sealed evaluation environment and broke into Hugging Face's production environment, and also hacked multiple third-party accounts and services as part of the attack. The latest disclosure shows that the security incident, which stemmed from an internal security test, was more extensive in scope than

Source: The Hacker News  |  Severity: Critical  |  Age: 1h ago

item.title: 🟠 Chromium: CVE-2026-13037 Use after free in WebView
item.description:
Why this matters: Leadership context — useful for risk, budget, and vendor conversations.
This CVE was assigned by Chrome. Microsoft Edge (Chromium-based) ingests Chromium, which addresses this vulnerability. Please see [Google Chrome Releases](https://chromereleases.googleblog.com/2026) for more information.

Source: Microsoft Security Response Center  |  Severity: Important  |  Age: 10h ago
